Dhaka [Bangladesh], September 10 (ANI): Economic liberalization has put Bangladesh on a solid foundation since the current Awami League government has been in power for a long time.

Once called the bottomless basket of the world, Bangladesh's economy has now come of age, and the country's resilient economy now attracts foreign players, reported Bangladesh Live News.
